features.title: Fix the defects found during modularization: stop map markers, missing-order feedback, ETA transport and address, next-patient notification, app profile log
features.user_visible_behavior: The dispatch driver page and pharmacy process page show driver, patient and pharmacy markers again (built-in symbols instead of image files that do not exist), each marker opens its own stop even when another selected stop has no location, and clicking the driver marker does nothing instead of failing. A patient who sends a note or rating for an order that does not exist gets 'Order not found' (404) instead of a server error. Scheduled ETAs are routed by bicycle for bicycle drivers and, like on-demand ETAs, to each patient's primary address. The 'Your delivery is next' notification sent from dispatch pages measures to the patient's primary address as the driver app's does, and the order's ETA is stored in minutes. Updating part of a profile in the mobile app logs only the fields that changed.
